narrative.overview:
This is descriptive shorthand for the shipped marketing appearance. The user's supplied Modern Invites gradient and three lavender colors anchor a contemporary invitation studio. Expressive serif headings, larger artwork frames, violet actions, pale lavender grounds, open ruled lists, deep plum anchors, and restrained depth give the website a coherent stationery character.

Scope: the homepage, pricing, portfolio, about, gallery, inquiry, and their shared marketing components. Client invitation folders, sample artwork, dashboards, and admin tools remain outside this palette's authority. The shared scope is implemented through marketing page wrappers and the stylesheet at components/marketing/theme.css; legacy green and warm-neutral Tailwind tokens remain available for existing independent themes.

The homepage retains its approved romantic hero composition: branded purple wax seal, near-black serif copy, magenta emphasis, four overlapping invitation phones, and small keepsake ornaments. The remaining sections extend its identity through generous spacing, Instrument Serif titles, larger image-led invitation cards, layered service artwork, open feature and process lists, and a centered seal-led closing panel. Published content, pricing, navigation, invitation artwork, and functional behavior remain authoritative. Surface composition lives in the homepage, portfolio, and pricing briefs; Love & Crafts supplies inspiration for whitespace, expressive type, and calm motion only, without copying assets, code, exact compositions, or animations.
keyCharacteristics: Spacious sections with expressive serif headlines and readable Inter body and action text.
The supplied lavender gradient, pale reading surfaces, violet controls, restrained media frames, and a deep plum footer.
Solid pale supporting text on dark or violet surfaces; deep plum supporting text on light surfaces.
Invitation samples retain their own artwork and accent colors.
Homepage and portfolio share image-led invitation cards; features, process, and homepage packages use open ruled lists.
Visible server-rendered content, one-time reveals, gentle media movement, and immediate reduced-motion alternatives.
The hero retains its wax seal, keepsake ornaments, and four linked phones; only immediately visible imagery receives priority.

rules.name: The Single Palette Rule
rules.body: Use brand and marketing Tailwind tokens for the six public marketing routes. Custom CSS resolves them with Tailwind's theme() function. Keep the supplied gradient treatment shared through marketing-atmosphere; keep hero artwork and phone geometry scoped to the hero module. Legacy forest, sage, gold, ivory, and ink tokens are compatibility resources for independent themes, not the current marketing identity.

rules.name: The Sample Identity Rule
rules.body: Colors in portfolio item data and sample preview frames describe those invitations, not Modern Invites branding. Preserve their local values; do not promote them into shared brand tokens merely because they appear in a marketing card.

rules.name: The Shadow Color Rule
rules.body: Keep geometry and opacity when replacing a color literal. Pair a geometry utility with the named shadow color; do not substitute a generic shadow if that changes the established depth.

rules.name: The Complete Illustration Rule
rules.body: Contain complete illustrations inside the preview frame with 8px padding and the sample's pale local ground. Photograph previews retain their intentional cover crop and top alignment. The shared item data selects the fit; Jaydee & Bea uses the illustration treatment.

dos: Do use shared named colors for marketing identity and keep documented values aligned with Tailwind.
Do reuse the supplied gradient and shared lavender/violet tokens throughout marketing; keep the hero keepsake art and phone geometry scoped to its CSS module.
Do preserve client and sample palettes in their own folders or presentation data.
Do preserve established shadow geometry and alpha when replacing literals.
Do check mobile and desktop appearance, contrast, keyboard behavior, enlarged text, and reduced motion after styling changes.
Do reuse the shared invitation card and collection for homepage and portfolio, preserving each surface's scale, grid, and loading behavior.
Do keep open homepage lists and fine-rule actions scoped while preserving pricing patterns.
donts: Don't impose the marketing theme on client invitations or operational tools.
Don't copy brand color literals into new shared marketing components or revive the superseded green marketing motif.
Don't treat decorative sample colors as new shared brand colors.
Don't hide readable content behind JavaScript-dependent entrances.
